configurePresets.displayName: Raspberry Pi Zero (armv6) cross release build
configurePresets.description: Cross-compiles for the Pi Zero 1.1 (ARM1176JZF-S, armv6). Requires an armv6 arm-linux-gnueabihf toolchain -- see docs/CROSS_COMPILE.md; a generic Debian/Ubuntu armhf cross toolchain targets armv7 and will NOT run on this board.
